phase_a_catalog_only.contract: Existing inspector only: PostgreSQL catalog metadata, extension inventory, ownership aggregates and effective privileges. No migration-ledger rows or application-table reads.

phase_a2_fixed_row_aggregates.contract: Separate, fixed psql script in one read-only transaction. Reads only the migration ledger and aggregate profile represented by the sanitized staging manifest; emits one JSON object, no application rows, plus session_user/current_user, UTC observed_at and the runner-generated challenge nonce. SQL constants do not prove remote project or instance.
phase_a2_fixed_row_aggregates.permission: Not part of Phase A or the Phase A inspector Job. Requires a separately reviewed and authorized private SQL path and successful SELECT rights; otherwise STOP without grants or retry.
phase_a2_fixed_row_aggregates.manifest_sha256_note: Private manifest was not present in the development worktree; do not invent or version its hash. The local comparator computes it from the mode-0600 input when later supplied.

target_evidence.source: approved gcloud sql instances describe snapshot plus the fixed Cloud SQL Auth Proxy invocation
target_evidence.binding: runner-generated random nonce, query-output SHA-256, resource snapshot SHA-256, session_user and observed_at must match the SQL result
target_evidence.resource_snapshot_sha256: SHA-256 of the retained raw resource-snapshot.json
